function optional(a?: 'left', b?: 'right'): boolean { return a === b; }
function nullable(a: 1 | null, b: 2 | null): boolean { return a == b; }
function singleton(a: 1 | null, b: undefined): boolean { return a === b; }
function standalone(a: 1, b: null): boolean { return b !== a; }
console.log(optional(), optional('left'), nullable(null, null), singleton(null, undefined), standalone(1, null));

function localUndefined(undefined: number | string) {
  if (undefined === 1) {
    const narrow: 1 = undefined;
    return narrow;
  }
  return 0;
}
function globalUndefined(value: string | undefined) {
  if (value === undefined) return 0;
  return value.length;
}
console.log(localUndefined(1), localUndefined('x'), globalUndefined('abc'), globalUndefined(undefined));
